newsitem.title: MEXICO: Clinton likely to visit Mexico in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Clinton likely to visit Mexico in 1997.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton likely will make his first official visit to Mexico in 1997, Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo said on Monday.
The Mexican government news agency Notimex said Zedillo made the announcement on the visit after meeting Clinton in Manila during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum.
"Yes we can say that possibly in the first half of 1997 there will be another interview and this one certainly will occur at some place in Mexico," Notimex quoted Zedillo as saying.
